scientific_question: How strong was the model under the conventional processed benchmark?
principal_finding: Selected tree ensembles performed strongly on the frozen processed IDS2018 reference holdout.
what_changed: Models thresholds uncertainty calibration costs category slices and seeds were audited.
what_survived: High within-reference ranking and F1; no resolved balanced learner or calibration winner.
what_failed: Reference success did not itself establish chronology transfer prevalence or unseen-family validity.
what_this_axis_establishes: A credible conventional reference condition and its uncertainty.
what_this_axis_does_not_establish: Temporal cross-dataset operational or zero-day generalization.
residual_limitation: Early processed/rebalanced reference condition and incomplete full rerun reproducibility.

scientific_question: Were memberships and duplicate relationships compatible with claimed evaluation roles?
native_metric: row counts; overlap count; membership receipts
principal_finding: Frozen reference memberships were disjoint and the Stage22 development-to-final K79 overlap was zero.
what_changed: Later work added source-faithful membership and duplicate sanitization receipts.
what_survived: Explicit disjointness and one shared forward final target.
what_failed: Split receipts did not prove temporal session independence.
what_this_axis_establishes: The evaluated memberships are traceable and role-separated under frozen rules.
what_this_axis_does_not_establish: Independence of latent sessions or absence of all semantic duplicates.
residual_limitation: Raw external inputs are not fully available and safe interfaces do not reopen membership arrays.

scientific_question: Did benchmark conclusions survive chronology and forward evaluation?
principal_finding: Chronological development ranked higher on the shared forward target across five seeds while frozen thresholds transferred poorly.
what_changed: Random versus chronological development and family-aware controls were introduced.
what_survived: The ranking contrast survived five frozen seeds.
what_failed: Operating-point transfer; a single causal temporal explanation.
what_this_axis_establishes: Ranking and threshold transfer must be evaluated separately under chronology.
what_this_axis_does_not_establish: Universal superiority of temporal splitting or proof of concept drift.
residual_limitation: Chronology and family composition remain entangled; timestamp provenance was incomplete in Stage18.

scientific_question: Do apparent gains survive removal or isolation of plausible shortcut features?
native_metric: SHAP agreement;LIME fidelity;subset PR-AUC and ROC-AUC;control metrics
principal_finding: Attribution and subset effects were informative but conditional on split learner and representation.
what_changed: Global attribution local-fidelity checks seven subsets placebo/stump controls and proxy absorption were added.
what_survived: Some feature sensitivities and stable TreeSHAP decomposition.
what_failed: A universal removal benefit or single causal shortcut mechanism.
what_this_axis_establishes: Shortcut dependence is an empirical sensitivity dimension.
what_this_axis_does_not_establish: That named features caused transfer failure.
residual_limitation: Ablations are observational; historical explanation artifacts are partly reproducible.

scientific_question: Does ranking transfer between IDS2018 and CICIDS2017?
principal_finding: Forward bridge62 retained signal but reverse bridge62 was near baseline; directions were asymmetric.
what_changed: A frozen bidirectional bridge and serialization sensitivity were added.
what_failed: Symmetric transfer and two GROUNDED_S4 cells.
what_this_axis_establishes: Transfer must be directional bridge-specific and preprocessing-aware.
what_this_axis_does_not_establish: Generalization to arbitrary datasets or an average transfer score.
residual_limitation: Bridge restrictions preprocessing differences conditional intervals and two cancelled cells.

scientific_question: What happens when frozen rates are translated to lower deployment prevalence and SOC constraints?
principal_finding: Base rate cost and workload assumptions can reverse practical preference and separate PPV workload and yield.
what_changed: Frozen operating points were projected across a preregistered prevalence grid and cost scenarios.
what_survived: Transparent deterministic translation from frozen rates.
what_failed: A universal operational winner or field-validated workload claim.
what_this_axis_establishes: Operational interpretation depends on prevalence capacity and costs.
what_this_axis_does_not_establish: Observed SOC utility under real drift or changing conditional rates.
residual_limitation: Prior-shift invariant-rate analyst-time and relative-cost assumptions.

scientific_question: Are the evaluated paths computationally feasible?
principal_finding: Measured compatible paths have auditable computational profiles; unsupported paths remain unsupported.
what_changed: Packet-image architecture comparison and hardware-aware deployment profiling were added.
what_failed: Complete backend coverage and hardware-independent timing claims.
what_this_axis_establishes: Deployment cost is a separate validity axis.
what_this_axis_does_not_establish: Universal latency throughput or architecture superiority.
residual_limitation: Stage26 hardware/software specificity and incomplete backend/artifact availability.

scientific_question: What survives when an eligible attack family is withheld?
principal_finding: Transfer was selective: three families were stable across both learners BOT was learner-dependent and Infiltration remained descriptive.
what_changed: Known-category slices became frozen LOAO eligibility testing and five-seed closure.
what_survived: Several eligible family patterns across realizations.
what_failed: Universal zero-day detection; inference for ineligible or low-support families.
what_this_axis_establishes: Novel-family performance is family learner threshold and support dependent.
residual_limitation: Two ineligible families; Infiltration support 36; study-specific taxonomy.

scientific_question: Are central temporal and unseen-family conclusions tied to one realization?
native_metric: winner frequency;mean and SD;5/5 ordering;family stability status
principal_finding: Central Stage22 ranking and several Stage27 family patterns survived the frozen seed set while some learner choices remained realization-dependent.
what_changed: Five fixed reference seeds and a 108-fit final closure were added.
what_survived: Chronological-over-random ordering in 5/5 seeds and selected family stability.
what_failed: Population-level guarantees significance claims and BOT learner invariance.
what_this_axis_establishes: Which main conclusions are stable over the preregistered model realizations.
what_this_axis_does_not_establish: Universality beyond five seeds or repeated full HPO.
residual_limitation: Finite seed set and reuse of the shared historical holdout.
